item.title: Adobe Acrobat/Reader PDF Exploit Generator — Claimed Prototype Pollution (CVE-2026-3462)
item.description:
Metadata

Field Value
Date Added 2026-07-05
Last Updated 2026-04
Author / Researcher NULL200OK (NABEEL)
CVE / Advisory CVE-2026-3462 (repo internally references CVE-2026-34621 — CVE-ID mismatch, see Notes)
Category misc
Severity Critical
CVSS Score Not specified in source
Status Weaponized
Tags pdf, exploit-generator, prototype-pollution, sandbox-escape, evasion, persistence, malware-generator, farmed-repo-suspected
Related N/A

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System Adobe Acrobat / Acrobat Reader (DC Continuous and 2024 Classic tracks)
Versions Affected Acrobat/Reader DC <= 26.001.21367; Acrobat 2024 <= 24.001.30356 (per repo’s own claims, unverified against the actual CVE-2026-3462 record)
Language / Platform Python 3 generator producing a malicious PDF targeting Windows/macOS
Authentication Required No (requires victim to open the generated PDF)
Network Access Required No (local file execution; optional staged-payload download requires network)

Summary

This repository is titled and described as a PoC for “Acrobat Reader Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes (Prototype Pollution)” under CVE-2026-3462, but the actual shipped code (poc.py / cve_2026_34621_advanced.py, both identical) is a generic, banner-branded “Advanced Cross-Platform Exploit Generator” for a different, self-assigned identifier (CVE-2026-34621). Rather than a narrow, scoped reproduction of a specific parser bug, the script is a full malicious-PDF builder: it auto-detects the victim OS, embeds OS-specific command execution (cmd.exe/PowerShell/WScript.Shell on Windows, Terminal.app/osascript on macOS), supports staged second-stage payload downloads, installs persistence (registry Run key / LaunchAgent), offers three levels of JavaScript obfuscation, supports lure-PDF merging to disguise the payload as a legitimate document, and generates HTML/TXT/JSON “campaign” reports. This is weaponized offensive tooling rather than a minimal vulnerability-scoped PoC, and the CVE-ID mismatch between the repo’s title (3462) and its own code/README (34621) suggests a templated or farmed exploit repo rather than an original disclosure.

item.title: WinRAR Windows Path Traversal via NTFS Alternate Data Streams (CVE-2025-8088)

CVE / Advisory CVE-2025-8088
Category misc
Severity High
CVSS Score 8.4 (CVSSv3)
Status Weaponized
Tags path-traversal, WinRAR, NTFS, Alternate-Data-Streams, RomCom, Storm-0978, persistence, startup-folder, in-the-wild
Related CVE-2025-6218

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System WinRAR (Windows)
Versions Affected Prior to WinRAR 7.13
Language / Platform Python (PoC generator)
Authentication Required No (victim must open/extract the crafted archive)
Network Access Required No (local file processing; delivered via phishing/decoy document)

Summary

CVE-2025-8088 is a path traversal vulnerability in the Windows version of WinRAR. A specially crafted RAR archive abuses NTFS Alternate Data Streams (ADS) combined with ..\ traversal sequences so that, when opened or extracted by a vulnerable WinRAR build, files are written outside the intended extraction directory. Reported real-world exploitation (attributed to RomCom / Storm-0978) used decoy documents visible to the victim while hidden ADS-backed entries dropped attacker-controlled files into sensitive locations such as the Windows Startup folder, enabling follow-on execution of LNK, HTA, VBScript, or PowerShell loaders on next login. This is a distinct vulnerability from the earlier CVE-2025-6218 WinRAR path-traversal bug already in this archive. Patched in WinRAR 7.13 (July 2025).

CVE / Advisory CVE-2026-7574
Category binary
Severity High
CVSS Score 8.7 (CVSSv3.1; AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L)
Status PoC
Tags LPE, persistence, VM-integrity, rootfs, Claude, AI-application, macOS, ext4, integrity-bypass, Shell
Related N/A

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System Anthropic Claude Desktop — Cowork feature
Versions Affected v1.1348.0 through v1.2278.0 (macOS)
Language / Platform Bash (PoC); macOS (target)
Authentication Required Yes (local unprivileged macOS user)
Network Access Required No (local only)

Summary

CVE-2026-7574 is a VM image integrity bypass in Anthropic’s Claude Desktop Cowork feature (macOS). Before booting the Cowork virtual machine, the application validates only the presence of rootfs.img and its associated version marker (.rootfs.img.origin); it performs no cryptographic hash or signature verification on the image contents. A local attacker with standard macOS user privileges can extract the ext4 VM filesystem, inject arbitrary payloads (cron scripts, startup modifications, persistence mechanisms), repack the image, and place it back. On every subsequent Cowork launch the tampered image boots and executes attacker code inside the VM — including in host-mounted directories. The persistence survives application restarts and updates. Presented at Recon 2026.
